# Cully 0.16.0

- **Update your CLI with `cully update`.** Check without changing anything with `--check`, or choose a release with `--version vX.Y.Z`. Downloads require a matching SHA-256 checksum and expected binary version before atomic replacement. Existing agent symlinks keep using the same binary, and an already running local advisor restarts. Open a new Cully terminal to use the updated wrapper.
- **Tell the advisor how you work.** The first interactive Cully launch offers an optional `dev-workflow-rules` skill covering responsibilities, codebases, build/test/release habits, infrastructure aliases, access boundaries and advice preferences. Preview and confirm before saving, skip the offer, or run `cully workflow` later. Existing skills are preserved. The private local profile is supplied to the configured advisor model as bounded, redacted context; it grants no infrastructure access and is not automatically saved to memory or included in web research.
- **Divider hover and cursor now work.** Mouse handling now calls the hover and cursor helpers, so the divider grip highlights under the pointer and requests a vertical-resize cursor on hover and drag. Cursor appearance depends on terminal support for OSC 22. In Warp, enable dragging with `Ctrl+\`, then press it again or Esc to restore host scrolling.
- **VM registry migration helper.** `deploy/migrate-registry-namespace.sh` moves installed website, docs and personal-data controllers to `ghcr.io/tavric-labs`, with a dry run, snapshot and local rollback-image retags.

The updater changes the local CLI and running advisor. Refresh skills and hooks with `cully setup` using your original options. Upgrade MCP, the data API, Mem0 and databases using your deployment tooling; see the [deployment guide](https://docs.cully.net/team-deployment#upgrade-services).

Older CLIs without `cully update` can install this version by rerunning the [installer](https://docs.cully.net/installation).
